input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: The licence provisions satisfy the preferred position in full. Section 13.1 grants the access right directly to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf, with no written-notice precondition, exceeding the fallback. Section 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software and Vendor Technology and expressly permits contractors to support that material. Section 13.3 limits Vendor revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the subscription licence is not revocable at will. Section 13.3 with Section 24.1 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without Vendor consent, reinforced by Section 24.4. The Section 13.4 restrictions are narrow and expressly do not limit authorized testing or use of Customer Data and output, so they do not undercut agreed use. No redline required.
